scope: Campus only; revised private styling proposal
selection_reason: Whole outfit: soft pink cable texture, light-blue casual denim, low-profile white/gum sneakers and practical natural-grid canvas. Useful product review evidence and reasonable value considered together. Neither pink nor price alone qualifies an item.

products.name: ANRABESS short-sleeve cable-knit polo sweater
products.variant: Pink; inspected Medium, choose individual size from measurements
products.why_selected: The soft dusty pink, open polo collar and cable texture supply the feminine preppy detail. Its relaxed shape works with a small front tuck into denim; no need for a matching pink skirt or decorative accessories.
products.limitations: Buyer feedback is broadly positive for quality, softness and value. Visible verified buyers describe holding shape after washing. Fit feedback varies; pink can read dustier than the listing photo. Not cotton/cashmere and not a long-term wear test.
products.evidence: Selected Pink retail photograph, material, seller, offer and customer review text inspected 7 October 2026. In Stock for inspected Medium.

products.name: Lee Legendary denim skirt
products.variant: Best in Show (light blue); inspected size 8, choose individual size from measurements
products.materials: 99% cotton, 1% spandex; zipper/button closure; five pockets
products.why_selected: A straightforward denim skirt gives the textured pink knit a wearable casual base. The lighter blue and white sneakers keep it fresh. Straight below-knee shape, real pockets and a back walking slit; no synthetic school-uniform skirt or fussy pleats.
products.limitations: Visible verified buyers in this colour praised denim quality and wearability. Waist sizing gets mixed feedback, so use actual measurements. Below-knee length; do not turn it into a mini. Physical wear not tested.
products.evidence: Selected Best in Show retail photograph, material, seller, offer and customer review text inspected 7 October 2026. Listing centre-front measurement 27 3/8 inches. In Stock for inspected size 8.

products.name: Reebok Club C 85 sneakers
products.variant: White/Light Grey/Gum; inspected size 9, select actual wearer size
products.materials: Leather upper; rubber sole; white low-top with gum outsole
products.seller_observed: Shopbop (an Amazon company); ships from Amazon
products.why_selected: A clean low-profile white sneaker suits this casual denim outfit better than an expensive office loafer. Its gum edge relates to the natural canvas bag without adding another competing colour.
products.limitations: Broadly positive comfort/style feedback; fit can be narrow and durability/cushioning feedback is mixed. Do not promise universal all-day comfort or guaranteed longevity. Selected-colour reviews were inspected, not treated as the whole rating sample.
products.evidence: Selected White/Light Grey/Gum photograph, live colour, size, offer, seller and review section inspected 7 October 2026. In Stock for inspected size 9.

products.name: BAGGU Horizontal Zip Duck Bag
products.materials: 16 oz recycled cotton canvas; machine washable
products.why_selected: Substantial documented canvas, zip closure, useful carry handles/adjustable strap and quiet black grid on natural canvas. Adds pattern and utility without making every item pink.
products.limitations: Listing fit claim is for a 15-inch MacBook; do not expand it to all laptops. No physical seam/zipper wear test.
products.evidence: Actual retail product photographs, 16 oz canvas and dimensions, seller, offer and current availability inspected 7 Oct 2026. Dimensions displayed: 12.5 x 17 x 4.25 inches.

prices: Observed size-specific offers before tax/shipping, not universal or future prices.

prompts.basic:
Create ONE realistic portrait 2:3 overhead editorial product photograph. Attach actual selected-variant retail photos for all four pieces; they control colour, material, cut and construction. Inventory: a rose Lacoste short-sleeved ribbed knit polo with white-edged collar and sleeve cuffs, actual button placket and small embroidered crocodile; a navy Lacoste short cotton-gabardine pleated skirt with the actual broad waistband/yoke and pleats; black leather Sam Edelman Loraine low-heel almond-toe loafers with small gold bit hardware; a natural-canvas BAGGU Horizontal Zip Duck Bag with a fine black grid, zipper, top handles and adjustable strap.
SURFACE: a pale lilac matte-paper surface with a small ivory linen corner; no wood, bench or bedroom.
COMPOSITION: Fold the navy skirt into a loose broad fan at upper left with yoke and real pleats visible. Angle the rose knit at centre-right, one sleeve turned under, collar/placket/cuffs identifiable. Lay tote open and flat across lower right with zipper, handles and grid pattern visible, separated from knit. Pair loafers on a diagonal at lower left. Do not arrange top directly above skirt into a body silhouette. All four linked pieces clearly visible.
Use natural directional light, visible knit stitches, crisp cotton-gabardine pleats, realistic leather grain and substantial canvas. Do not invent luxury texture absent from source photos, or replace the products with generic pink versions. Preserve genuine small product marks; no invented branding or movie/sorority text. No pink hoodie, pink sports skort, striped knee socks, jewellery, headband, extra bag or extra shoes. All products within frame.
REQUIRED LABEL: reserve light negative space at top. Large pink brush-script "campus crush"; immediately below, solid BLACK uppercase "THE PINK CAMPUS EDIT". Make subtitle visibly readable at phone size, not tiny hairline type. No scrapbook frame, tape or sticker panel. Exact wording; a clean unlabelled photo is not a finished BASIC. Photographic realism, no plastic shine.
prompts.styled:
Create ONE realistic portrait 2:3 styled still-life photo with NO person. Attach actual selected retail photographs and approved BASIC for product continuity ONLY. Inventory: a rose Lacoste short-sleeved ribbed knit polo with white-edged collar and sleeve cuffs, actual button placket and small embroidered crocodile; a navy Lacoste short cotton-gabardine pleated skirt with the actual broad waistband/yoke and pleats; black leather Sam Edelman Loraine low-heel almond-toe loafers with small gold bit hardware; a natural-canvas BAGGU Horizontal Zip Duck Bag with a fine black grid, zipper, top handles and adjustable strap.
SETTING: An adult apartment living room: full-size cream sofa, deep rose velvet armchair, rounded dark coffee table, substantial rug and a bookcase. A believable adult room with texture and rose accents; no bench, nursery, dormitory bed or product showroom.
CAMERA: From the SIDE of the room at seated eye level, looking diagonally across chair, coffee table and near floor. The chair back, table legs and floor establish depth.
STAGING: Drape the rose knit naturally over the empty rose chair arm, with the actual collar and cuffs visible. Place the navy skirt unfolded over one side of the cream sofa, hem and pleats visible. The BAGGU tote stands on the floor with its top handles, zipper and black grid identifiable. Pair loafers beside it. Two plain closed books on coffee table are unlinked context only. Do not duplicate BASIC arrangement or put all clothes on one bench.
This must look like a considered grown-up outfit in a real home, with different object relationships from the overhead BASIC. Preserve exact retail colours, collar, knit pattern, skirt yoke/pleats/short length, gold shoe hardware and grid tote construction. Every linked piece recognizable; no generic replacement. Clothes have ordinary empty folds and gravity, no invisible person wearing them. No hoodie, pink sports skort, striped socks or added wearable accessories. No title, collage or decorative lettering. Soft daylight with tactile adult furniture, no nursery styling or pastel pillow pile.
prompts.lifestyle:
Create ONE realistic portrait 2:3 candid full-body photograph of Tommy Kate. Attach her approved identity reference FIRST, exact selected retail product photographs NEXT, and approved STYLED LAST for continuity only. Inventory: a rose Lacoste short-sleeved ribbed knit polo with white-edged collar and sleeve cuffs, actual button placket and small embroidered crocodile; a navy Lacoste short cotton-gabardine pleated skirt with the actual broad waistband/yoke and pleats; black leather Sam Edelman Loraine low-heel almond-toe loafers with small gold bit hardware; a natural-canvas BAGGU Horizontal Zip Duck Bag with a fine black grid, zipper, top handles and adjustable strap.
CAMERA AND ACTION: From across a brick courtyard at chest height, photograph her walking past an old university library, three-quarter side view. She wears the rose knit polo at its actual regular length with the navy pleated skirt and black leather bit loafers; BAGGU natural-grid tote on one shoulder. One hand adjusts its strap, gaze toward the open library doorway. Soft autumn daylight, ordinary cream stone and a few fallen leaves. Show both shoes and actual skirt hem. This is outdoors with human motion, not the living-room still life with an avatar added.
Keep identity solely from reference; preserve exact product cut, colour, collar/cuff contrast, placket, skirt pleats and bag pattern. No added jewellery, headband, socks, jacket or extra bag. No movie branding, university crest, invented product marks, titles, collage or watermark. Real adult proportions, physically plausible hands and straps, realistic texture. Do not retouch products to look more luxurious than their reference photographs.
